Prompt / specification: Wet growing medium holds moisture and fertilizer against joints and hidden panel edges. Options: Use a removable planting insert or drained liner separated from the shell | Use naturally durable boards with open drainage and replaceable interior parts | Fill a sealed plywood box directly with soil

Drainage that exists only as holes may still stain surfaces, rot feet, or affect spaces below. Options: Route water through a visible serviceable outlet to an approved destination | Use a removable tray with defined overflow and inspection | Let water find deck gaps

Wet soil makes a compact planter far heavier and more top-heavy than its empty shell. Options: Use a separately rated low rolling platform based on saturated load | Use fixed feet and move only when empty | Add small furniture casters after planting
